question: In which one of the following Indian state is Mawsynram located which is at present the wettest place in India, with an average annual rainfall of 11802.4 mm (average of the 1974 - 2022 period)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__**.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The highest rainfall in India is at Cherrapunji(Present name Sohra) in Mawsynram village of Meghalaya state.**
 
• **The Average rainfall of **Cherrapunji is 11,777 mm or 463.7 in.
 
• Mawsynram **is located in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya**. 
 
• It is **surrounded by hills on three sides and is on the windward side of the hills. **
 
• The **Bay of Bengal branch of the monsoon gets trapped in the funnel-shaped depression caused by the Khasi range. **
 
• **The moist air from the Bay of Bengal is lifted, cooled, and condensed, resulting in heavy rainfall. **
 
• **In 1985, Mawsynram received a record 26,000 m**m of rain.​

 **Less than 50 cm**
 
 
 
• **Western Rajasthan, **
 
• **Ladakh in Jammu & Kashmir.**
